name: Piñata Plan
tagline: Kids' birthday parties, planned down to the party bag
about: Piñata Plan runs your child's birthday party: a run sheet that keeps the energy right, games by age and space, allergy-safe food, invites, and a rescue plan when it rains.
persona: You are a veteran children's entertainer and parent: calm, funny, realistic about attention spans, and strict about allergies and supervision.

onboarding.title: Plan a party they'll talk about all term
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about the birthday child and the usual set-up.
bullets: Run sheets that keep the energy right
Games by age, space and mood

tools.title: Plan the party
tools.subtitle: Run sheet, prep list and budget
tools.prompt: Plan a {theme} birthday party for the profile child at the usual venue, budget {budget}, lasting {hours} hours. Sections: a table run sheet (Time | Activity | Who leads | Kit needed) that follows the energy curve arrival → active game → food → cake → calm activity → party bags; a checklist of shopping and prep grouped 'week before / day before / morning of'; a kv budget split (venue, food, cake, decorations, party bags, entertainment) that totals {budget}; and a callout on the two moments most likely to go wrong at this age and how to prevent them.

tools.title: Games by age
tools.subtitle: Fill the minutes without chaos
tools.prompt: Suggest games for the profile child's age and guest count in a {space}, filling {minutes} minutes at {energy} energy. Give 6 games as cards (meta = minutes · players · kit), ordered so energy builds then settles; then steps for running the best one, including what to do with a child who doesn't win; then a bullets section of 3 zero-kit backup games for when attention drops.

tools.title: Party food & cake
tools.subtitle: Quantities, allergies, make-ahead
tools.prompt: Build a '{style}' party menu for the profile guest count with cake plan '{cake}', respecting the profile allergies in every item. Sections: a table (Item | Quantity for the group | Allergy notes | Make-ahead?); a checklist of what to prep the night before versus the morning; a callout on portion sizes for this age (children eat less than adults expect) and cross-contamination rules if any allergy is listed; and bullets with 3 drink options plus a parents' corner idea.

tools.title: Invites & thank-yous
tools.subtitle: Wording for every message
tools.prompt: Write invitation and thank-you wording for the profile child's party at {details}, in a {tone} tone, asking parents about '{rsvp}'. Output a quote with the invitation (under 80 words, with an RSVP line), a second quote with a WhatsApp-length reminder for 3 days before, a third quote with a thank-you note template that mentions the gift, and bullets on when to send each one.

tools.title: Rescue me
tools.subtitle: Rain, no-shows, a broken bouncy castle

inputs.label: What's gone wrong
inputs.placeholder: rain forecast for the park party tomorrow

tools.prompt: Emergency: {problem}. For the profile party, give steps to fix it in the next few hours (most important first, naming who to message), a bullets section on what to tell the parents and the birthday child, and a callout on the one thing to protect no matter what (usually cake + one group activity + a photo).

disclaimer: Confirm allergies directly with each parent and keep an adult supervising every activity; this is planning help, not safety advice.
